judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD test-writing phase and did not implement any of the production code changes. While it drafted `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, `.lore/dod.md`, and acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`, it never touched `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or added `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, the new tests will fail immediately because input validation does not exist yet. Furthermore, all documentation and metadata requirements (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`) were completely omitted, and the test file names do not match the specific paths requested in the acceptance criteria (`registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`).
